findings.evidence: The header publicly imports these modules at lines 8 and 10; `DifferentiableOn.analyticOnNhd` is defined at `Mathlib/Analysis/Complex/CauchyIntegral.lean:631`, while CauchyIntegral itself publicly imports measure integration, divergence-theorem, and circle-integral modules that do not occur in any declaration signature here.
findings.fix: Make both imports private and publicly import only the lightweight analytic/derivative modules required by declaration signatures, likely `Calculus.FDeriv.Analytic` (currently private) plus `Calculus.Deriv.Basic`.
findings.issue: `Analytic.Uniqueness` and especially `Complex.CauchyIntegral` are public imports although their identity-principle and differentiability-to-analytic results are used only in proof bodies, making every API consumer inherit substantial unrelated dependencies.

summary: The continuation API unnecessarily re-exports large proof-only Mathlib modules.
